series_start_reason: Series starts 2017Q3, the earliest quarter any AbbVie filing prints separately for Venclexta. AbbVie's own filings for 2016Q2-2018Q2 print no Venclexta figure; the 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2018 is the first to carry a revenues-by-product note, and its prior-year columns give 2017Q3 (33) and nine months 2017 (78); the 2018 10-K gives full-year 2017 (122) and 2016 (18); the 2019 10-Qs give 2018Q1 and 2018Q2 as prior-year columns. 2017Q1-Q2 are printed only as part of the nine-month total, and 2016 only as a year, so neither can be split into quarters (not interpolated). Venclexta was approved 2016-04-11 (launch 2016Q2), five quarters before the series starts.
search_log: Listed every filing (all forms, incl. 8-K, 8-K/A, 10-Q, 10-K) for CIK 0001551152 (AbbVie), 0000001800 (Abbott), 0001578845 (Allergan plc / Actavis plc), 0000855654 (ImmunoGen) and 0000850693 (Allergan, Inc.) via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. the older 'files' pages (scripts/list_filings.py); earnings 8-Ks selected by item 2.02 (also item 12 / 7,9 for 2003-2004 Abbott and Allergan, Inc. filings), exhibits resolved from each filing's index.json (scripts/earnings.py, exhibits.py).

Product rows pulled by table-row parsing of each earnings exhibit (scripts/abbvie_extract.py, abbott_extract.py, allergan_extract.py, allerganinc_extract.py); the quarter of an AbbVie block is read from the document's own '% Change vs. nQyy' header row; every series was checked for gaps and, where the Q4 release prints a full-year figure, quarters were summed against it (scripts/build_all.py).

Searched AbbVie FY2016/FY2017 10-K and 10-Qs 2016-2018 full text for 'Venclexta'/'VENCLEXTA': only regulatory/pipeline mentions, no net revenue figure; first revenue row 2018Q3 (U.S. 69, Int'l. 27, Total 96). 2018 has only Q3-Q4 so no full-year comparison; 2019-2025 quarters sum to the printed full-year figures.

[g4_us extension 2026-11] Listed AbbVie (CIK 1551152) 8-K item 2.02, 10-Q and 10-K filings 2016-04 to 2019-09 via data.sec.gov submissions and read every table row of each 8-K Exhibit 99.1, 10-Q and 10-K: no filing for a period before 2018Q3 prints a Venclexta line, but the 10-Qs from the September 2018 10-Q on carry a revenues-by-product note with prior-year columns (VENCLEXTA / United States / International / Total).

Added 2017Q3 (prior-year column, Sept 2018 10-Q: Total 96 | 33 | 220 | 78), 2017Q4 (FY2017 122 in the 2018 10-K less nine months 2017 78 = 44), 2018Q1 (prior-year column, March 2019 10-Q: 151 | 59) and 2018Q2 (prior-year column, June 2019 10-Q: 169 | 65 | 320 | 124).

Checks: 2018Q1 59 + 2018Q2 65 = 124, the six months 2018 printed in the June 2019 10-Q; 2018 quarters 59 + 65 + 96 + 124 = 344, the full-year 2018 Total printed in the 2018 10-K. 2017Q1 and 2017Q2 are not separable: the only 2017 figures printed are full-year 122, nine months 78 and 2017Q3 33, so 2017H1 (45) is known only as a sum; 2016 is printed only as a full year (18).
